name: Linda Gaspard
bio:
Linda Gaspard brings more than 45 years of real estate experience to Gaspard & Co Real Estate. Since beginning her career in 1979, she has helped buyers and sellers throughout the Greater Baton Rouge Area navigate some of life’s most meaningful moves.

Working alongside her family, Linda brings decades of perspective and a personal approach to the Gaspard & Co office. She understands that every move has a story, whether clients are purchasing their first home, making room for a growing family, or preparing for a new chapter.

Linda’s longstanding career reflects the values at the heart of Gaspard & Co: family, experience, and helping people find their way home.
